classes.establishes: A theorem follows from the exact formal definitions and stated assumptions under the admitted proof-kernel and axiom policy.
The selected supported Rust source semantics, under the exact recorded translation pipeline, satisfy the stated formal relationship.
does_not_establish: coverage of excluded or unsupported source behavior

classes.establishes: The selected executable Rust subject satisfies the exact verifier contracts under the recorded verifier trust boundary.
No specified safety violation was found inside the exact retained finite model/configuration/state-space profile.
The named temporal or reachability property holds under the exact retained model/checker/configuration/fairness/bound profile.
The implementation and formal model agree under the exact stated projection/refinement relation for the retained bounded traces.
The exact runtime subject exhibited the claimed bounded behavior under the exact retained qualification environment/profile.
does_not_establish: general behavior outside the qualification profile

mandatory_non_equivalences: Alloy UNSAT != theorem outside the declared scope
formal verification != permission for external effects

experimental_tools.Quint: Admit only as a bounded model-based-testing/developer bridge unless a later reviewed architecture explicitly promotes it.
experimental_tools.Creusot: Evaluate only for a concrete important Rust proof materially blocked in Verus; not part of the v1 standard toolchain.
experimental_tools.Hax: May be evaluated as a developer/extraction frontend but not counted as an independent Lean proof lineage when it shares the Charon/Aeneas path.
